title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
九州大地，广阔无边，是武者荟萃的世界。此地群雄并起，大秦、大隋、大汉、武周、大明、大元七大国势均力敌；北宋南宋虽同源，却各有千秋，外敌来犯时，二者联手可与任何强国抗衡。同时，这片土地上还有诸多势力割据，大理、西夏、吐蕃、大辽、东瀛、大金等皆存于世。数十年来，大国看似安定，实则波涛暗涌，小国之间战火频仍，而大国往往袖手旁观，专心发展军备。大秦嬴政胸怀壮志，欲统一天下。他注定要掀起一场惊天动地的大战。江湖之中，武者汇聚。少林、武当、丐帮、魔门六道、慈航静斋、逍遥派等名门大派引领风潮，更不乏众多隐匿其间的中小派系。南宋山林深处，一名婴儿躺在草丛中四下张望。黄玉风心中满是困惑，昨日因升职加薪欣喜若狂，饮了几杯酒庆祝，醒来却发现自己变成婴儿，身处荒郊野外。若非及时脱身，恐已难逃厄运。若要选个毒虫猛兽试手，他恐怕早就没命了。黄雨锋本是个孤儿，闲暇时爱看小说消磨时光。如今忽然醒来，发现自己竟回到了童年，意识到这是穿越了，还带着穿入的设定。或许是穿越之力的缘故，他竟以新生儿状态重生，浑身赤裸地躺在草地上，好在脚下是柔软的草地，否则免不了摔伤。为何别人的开局都是帝王血脉，或者仙门大佬？轮到他，却只是个无依无靠的婴儿，连最基本的衣服都没保住，全毁于时空能量之中。这运气，实在让人难以接受。老天爷，你也太偏心了吧！黄雨锋默默抱怨着，呼唤所谓的金手指——“系统”出现。然而，无论他如何呼唤，都得不到回应。他不甘心，尝试了多种方式，依旧徒劳无果。情急之下，他只能放声大喊求救，可传出的却是婴儿般稚嫩的哭声，令他几近绝望。这荒郊野外的，谁能听见他的呼救？他只能祈祷奇迹降临。恰在此时，黄药师正携冯蘅游玩附近，隐约听见了婴儿的啼哭。他大为惊异，在这人迹罕至之地怎会有婴儿？冯蘅问：“药师，你为何停步？”黄药师回道：“听，这附近好像有婴儿哭声，我们去看看。”冯蘅点头：“好，快去看看，别让孩子在外头待太久。”片刻后，二人来到黄雨锋身旁。

看到有人靠近，他顿时兴奋地咧嘴笑起，觉得有救了。黄药师和冯蘅身着古装，一表人才，显然这里是古代。他心中闪过一丝希望，但又不确定是否是自己熟知的那个世界。冯蘅温柔地道：“这孩子冲我们笑呢，多可爱啊。不知是谁忍心将刚出生的婴儿抛在这里，我们带他回去吧？”话音未落，她已将黄雨锋抱起。温暖的怀抱让黄雨锋感到些许安慰，他对这对救命恩人充满感激，暗下决心将来必当回报。冯蘅话音刚落，黄药师并未回应，而是专注地查看黄雨锋的资质。结果令他十分惊喜——这孩子竟天生百脉俱通。这一发现让黄药师激动不已。他当即决定收黄雨锋为徒，相信只要勤奋修炼，超越自己并非难事。冯蘅好奇地问：“药师，为何这般兴奋？”见黄药师检查完毕，冯蘅便询问缘由。黄药师答道：“阿蘅，我打算收此子为徒，他天赋异禀，日后勤加苦练，定能在江湖上留下美名。”冯蘅听闻此言，心中欢喜。初次见面时，她就觉得这孩子可爱，此刻更觉欣慰。但随即想到一事，便对黄药师说道：“药师，我们还不知他本名，不如替他取个新名如何？”黄药师沉思片刻，点头应允，“那就随我姓氏吧，我门下弟子皆带‘锋’字，看他骨骼清奇，气质非凡，就唤作黄雨锋吧。”如此，黄雨锋之名就此定下。冯蘅抱着怀中的孩子，温柔笑道：“小家伙，从今以后你就叫黄雨锋啦，可喜欢这个名字呀？”黄雨锋听罢，内心震撼。他从未想过此界能修真，而这位被称为药师的人竟称其资质绝佳，这让他倍感喜悦，只是不知这是怎样的世界。听到二人给自己取名，他又一次感到幸运，因为新名竟与旧名相同。或许这就是命运使然，他欣然一笑，毕竟这个名字已陪伴他多年，骤然更改难免不适，保留原名自然最好不过。“看，他在笑呢！定是极喜欢这个名字！”冯蘅笑语盈盈。黄药师也满意地颔首。“好了，阿蘅，咱们在外多时，该回桃花岛了。”
content_en:
The vast land of Kyushu is a world where warriors gather.The seven great kingdoms of Qin, Sui, Han, Wuzhou, Ming, and Yuan are evenly matched here. Although the Northern and Southern Song Dynasties share the same origin, they each have their own merits. When foreign enemies invade, the two can join forces to compete with any powerful country.At the same time, there are still many separate forces in this land, including Dali, Xixia, Tubo, Daliao, Dongying, Dajin, etc.For decades, big countries seem to be stable, but in fact there are turbulent times. Wars between small countries are frequent, while big countries often stand aside and concentrate on developing armaments.Yingzheng of the Great Qin Dynasty had great ambitions and wanted to unify the world.He is destined to start an earth-shattering war.In the rivers and lakes, warriors gathered.Famous sects such as Shaolin, Wudang, Beggar Clan, Six Paths of Demon Sect, Cihang Jingzhai, and Xiaoyao Sect are leading the trend, and there are also many small and medium-sized sects hiding among them.Deep in the mountains of the Southern Song Dynasty, a baby lay in the grass and looked around.Huang Yufeng was full of confusion. He was ecstatic about his promotion and salary increase yesterday and drank a few glasses of wine to celebrate. When he woke up, he found that he had turned into a baby and was in the wilderness.If he hadn't escaped in time, he might have been doomed.If he had chosen a poisonous insect and beast to try his hand at, he would probably have died long ago.Huang Yufeng was originally an orphan, and he loved reading novels to kill time in his spare time.Now I suddenly woke up and found that I had returned to my childhood. I realized that I had traveled through time, and it also carried the setting of time travel.Perhaps due to the power of time travel, he was reborn as a newborn, lying naked on the grass. Fortunately, there was soft grass under his feet, otherwise he would have been injured.Why do everyone else start with the blood of the emperor or the big boss of the Immortal Sect?When it was his turn, he was just a helpless baby, without even the most basic clothes, destroyed by the energy of time and space.This kind of luck is really hard to accept.God, you are too partial!Huang Yufeng complained silently, calling for the so-called golden finger - the "system" to appear.However, no matter how he called, there was no answer.He was unwilling to give in and tried many methods, but to no avail.In desperation, he could only scream for help, but what came out was a baby-like cry, which made him almost desperate.Who in this wilderness could hear his cry for help?He could only pray for a miracle.At this time, Huang Yaoshi and Feng Heng were playing nearby and vaguely heard the cry of the baby.He was greatly surprised. How could there be a baby in this inaccessible place?Feng Heng asked: "Yakist, why did you stop?" Huang Yaoshi replied: "Listen, there seems to be a baby crying nearby, let's go and have a look." Feng Heng nodded: "Okay, go and have a look, don't let the child stay outside for too long." After a while, the two came to Huang Yufeng's side.

Seeing someone approaching, he suddenly grinned excitedly, feeling that he was saved.Huang Yaoshi and Feng Heng were dressed in ancient costumes and looked talented. It was obvious that this was ancient times.There was a glimmer of hope in his heart, but he was not sure if it was the world he knew well.Feng Heng said softly: "This child is smiling at us, how cute he is. Who has the heart to leave a newborn baby here? Let's take him back?" Before she finished speaking, she had picked up Huang Yufeng.Huang Yufeng felt a little comforted by the warm embrace. He was grateful to the life-savers and secretly determined to repay them in the future.As soon as Feng Heng finished speaking, Huang Yaoshi did not respond, but focused on checking Huang Yufeng's qualifications.The result surprised him - this child was born with all the connections.This discovery excited Huang Yaoshi.He immediately decided to accept Huang Yufeng as his disciple, believing that as long as he practiced diligently, it would not be difficult to surpass himself.Feng Heng asked curiously: "Pharmacist, why are you so excited?" Seeing that Huang Yaoshi had finished the examination, Feng Heng asked the reason.Huang Yaoshi replied: "Ah Heng, I plan to accept this boy as my disciple. He is very talented. If he practices hard in the future, he will definitely leave a good name in the world." Feng Heng was very happy after hearing this.When they first met, she thought the child was cute, and she felt even more pleased now.But then he thought of something and said to Huang Yaoshi: "Yaoshi, we don't know his real name yet, how about giving him a new name?" Huang Yaoshi thought for a moment and nodded in agreement, "Then just follow my surname. All my disciples have the word 'Feng'. Seeing his strange bones and extraordinary temperament, let's call him Huang Yufeng." In this way, the name Huang Yufeng was decided.Feng Heng held the child in his arms and said with a gentle smile: "Little guy, from now on you will be called Huang Yufeng. Do you like this name?" After hearing this, Huang Yufeng was shocked in his heart.He had never thought that cultivation could be achieved in this world, but this person called the Medicine Master actually said that he had excellent qualifications. This made him feel very happy, but he didn't know what kind of world this was.Hearing that they had named themselves, he felt lucky again, because the new name was the same as the old name.Perhaps this was fate. He smiled happily. After all, this name had been with him for many years. A sudden change would inevitably cause discomfort, so it was best to keep the original name."Look, he is smiling! He must like this name very much!" Feng Heng smiled.Huang Yaoshi also nodded with satisfaction."Okay, Aheng, we have been out for a long time, it's time to go back to Peach Blossom Island."
